scientific_integrity: Exact finite-sample covariance and a bivariate CLT proved by explicit conditional integrals and Hoeffding decomposition; no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform matchings only; weak convergence without quantitative rate; source priority may be incomplete; 2000 Flajolet–Noy report predates the first day-exact verifiable public posting used for archival dating, but does not supply a day-exact public-access date.
title: Asymptotically independent crossing and nesting pair counts in random matchings
